[NDET.1.5] **On a target with no double FPU, the guarantee covers libds's clang
build.** On the RP2350, RP2040 and nRF52833 libds's own build uses clang and
nothing else, and a libds built for those targets with another toolchain is
outside the guarantee. libds's double arithmetic there is its own ([IARC.7.11]).
